The K-window log-derivative is evaluated on the canonical S52 8-mode Bogoliubov amplitudes (B2×4 deep at 0.7704 + B1 ungapped + B3×3 upper at 0.176). ### Natural-split recommendation (W3a / W3b decomposition; per `wave-classification.md §"NROY clause"` MIXED-class sub-wave-decomposition discipline)

W3 contains 11 gates spanning 8 substrate-physics COMPUTE-class items + 2 METHODOLOGY-class registry-text items (W3-1, W3-2) + 1 METHODOLOGY-class rule-file extension (W3-10). The 11-gate aggregate is at the high end of the "typical 6-15 range" per `/rclab-plan` discipline. Of the COMPUTE-class items, W3-4 (off-fold cache build at τ ∈ {0.18, 0.20}) is GPU-heavy (~7-8 we; 3-4 we per cache × 2 distinct τ values) and structurally gates W3-5 + W3-6 (Level-2 moduli items consuming the off-fold caches).

**Planner recommendation**: orchestrator splits W3 into two structurally-independent sub-waves at dispatch time:

- **W3a (substrate-physics + registry; ~5.6 we; 8 gates)**: W3-1 + W3-2 + W3-3 + W3-7 + W3-8 + W3-9 + W3-10 + W3-11. Volovik PRIMARY on substrate-physics derivations (W3-3, W3-7); volovik + connes-ncg JOINT on W3-7 (alternative envelope predictor) + connes-ncg PRIMARY on W3-8 + W3-9 (FULL-CC cross-route + layer-attribution); mack sole-writer on W3-1 + W3-2 (registry-text); orchestrator-direct on W3-10 (rule-file extension METHODOLOGY-class); cross-reviewer dispatch (vdd Axis-A + mack Axis-B per OAA §VII.AV exclusion) on W3-11 (§W8-2 re-dispatch). Dispatch in parallel; no shared GPU contention.

- **W3b (off-fold caches + Level-2 moduli retry; ~9-10 we; 3 gates)**: W3-4 (off-fold cache build at τ ∈ {0.18, 0.20}; volovik GPU-heavy) → W3-5 (CF-S91-W1-5.2 Level-2 retry; CONDITIONAL on W3-4) + W3-6 (CF-S92-W5-2.2 Level-2-INVARIANT extension; CONDITIONAL on W3-4). W3b is structurally a parallel-wave-together (W3-5 + W3-6 dispatch in parallel after W3-4 completes); W3-4 GPU contention forbids parallel dispatch with W3a GPU-using gates (none in W3a are GPU-heavy per machinery pins below, so W3a + W3b CAN dispatch in parallel if GPU budget allows).

**Alternative** (if S92 GPU budget cannot absorb W3-4's 7-8 we within session): defer W3-4 + W3-5 + W3-6 to S93+ via explicit mechanical-closure PRE-REG-INC at W3 dispatch, citing GPU budget constraint as the upstream block. The §VII.AV Stage-1-Candidate promotion (W3-1 + W3-2 + W3-11) proceeds with Level-1 single-slice evidence only; Level-2 moduli extension deferred. This is admissible under `mechanical-closure-discipline.md` 5-clause discipline iff the orchestrator's S92 dispatch plan documents the GPU budget at W3 wave-open.

Both decomposition decisions are tagged here as authoring recommendations; orchestrator selects at dispatch time per S92 GPU budget actuals.

```yaml
                  B1 ungapped at 1.0, B3×3 upper at 0.176) at τ_fold=0.19 per

                  Hochschild trace at substrate-distance-2 pole s=4 on the L_max-
                  truncated D_K spectrum cache; computed via the SCHEMATIC
                  _spectral_action_regulators.py helper (CLASS=SCHEMATIC pin
                  MANDATORY per substrate-first-canonical-sourcing.md §(iv)).

    Definition 4: saturation_ratio := |max_spread(L_max=12) − max_spread(L_max=10)|
                                       / |max_spread(L_max=10) − max_spread(L_max=8)|

    OPERATOR-MISMATCH PRE-FLIGHT (per math-scripts.md §"Plan-author discipline at

    cocycle pairing on the L_max-truncated cache; it inherits L_emp = -7.046336474406761
    M_KK² as the L_max=12 asymptotic anchor via the multiplicative-normalization
    cancellation rule (per math-scripts.md §"Multiplicative-normalization cancellation
    invariants" SUGGESTION K=1 MANDATORY for §VII.AV at substrate-distance-2 pole s=4).

    Substitute: max_spread(L_max=11) = evaluate B(R, L_max=11) for R ∈ {ζ, Pauli-Villars,
                                       Mellin, cutoff} on filtered master cache at L_max=11
                                       cap; compute (max − min) / median.
                max_spread(L_max=12) = same evaluation at L_max=12 cap (full master cache).
                saturation_ratio    = |max_spread(L_max=12) − max_spread(L_max=10)| /
                                      |max_spread(L_max=10) − max_spread(L_max=8)|
                                    = |max_spread(L_max=12) − 16.83%| / |16.83% − 14.41%|

                saturation_ratio > 1.5 ⇒ RD-axis-α-divergence direction
                saturation_ratio ∈ (1.0, 1.5] ⇒ MARGINAL transition direction
```

```yaml
substitution_chain:
  required: true
  content: |
    Definition 1: Stage-2 cross-axis independent-verify (per joint-theorem-promotion.md §'Stage 2'):
                  TWO cross-reviewers operating IN PARALLEL on OPPOSITE axes; BOTH operating
                  WITHOUT prior workshop context; JOINT clauses PASS-AND'd across BOTH verdicts
                  (logical AND, not OR); ANY clause FAIL routes back to STAGE-1-CANDIDATE.

    Definition 2: PASS-AND structural ceiling per joint-theorem-promotion.md §'Substrate-input-
                  orthogonality clause' MANDATORY K=3: PASS-AND across orthogonal-data observables
                  IS the structural ceiling; PASS-AND across same-data observables IS the procedural-
                  floor independence guarantee (carries substrate-input-overlap caveat). THIS gate
                  targets the structural ceiling via FULL-CC vs SCHEMATIC route orthogonality at
                  the FULL-CC observable (loaded by mack Axis-B only) and the SCHEMATIC observable
                  (loaded by vdd Axis-A only).

    Definition 3: Convention tag -SCHEMATIC → -FULL transition: S91 W8-CF-68 PRE-REG-INC closure
                  emitted under convention=cross-axis-axis-a-vdd-plus-axis-b-mack-orchestrator-
                  direct-FULL but blocked by W1 T1.1 + W5 T1.11 prereq missing under SCHEMATIC
                  pipeline; S92 W3-11 re-dispatch transitions to -FULL convention tag post-W1
                  CF-W9-4 FULL-CC pipeline landing (per Group A SCHEMATIC-vs-FULL adjudication
                  campaign W1 priority placement in session-92-context.md line 248).

    Definition 4: Option-A supersedes corrective protocol (per gate-verdicts.md §'Option A —
                  sig_5 remediation pathway under absolute verdict permanence' MANDATORY S88
                  W8-100 forward): original line RETAINED + corrective APPENDED with full 64-char
                  supersedes tag; downstream consumers cite latest non-superseded.

    OPERATOR-MISMATCH PRE-FLIGHT: the Stage-2 cross-reviewers audit clauses involving the
    canonical L_emp = -7.046336474406761 M_KK² observable per S87 W2-3 Def 4 / S89 W5-2 /
    S90 CF-61 (NOT the operator form +2s = +8 reduction which is INCOMPATIBLE). Convention-
    suffix carries PLAN-OPERATOR-CANONICAL-L-EMP-VERIFIED-2026-05-22.

    Substitute: Step 1: Verify upstream prereqs:
                  - W1 CF-W9-4 §VII.AF.1.OP-PROJ FULL-physical re-extraction PASS at
                    s92_gate_verdicts.txt (FULL-CC pipeline landing)
                  - W3-1 §VII.AV STAGE-1-CANDIDATE-PROMOTION PASS at s92_gate_verdicts.txt
                  IF any missing → mechanical-closure PRE-REG-INC per upstream_prereq pin.
                Step 2: Verify Axis-B Selection Protocol 3-condition conjunction:
                  - axis-distinctness: vdd ≠ volovik axis; mack ≠ volovik axis; ✓
                  - original-authoring-agent exclusion: neither vdd nor mack authored W1 + W5
                    + W8 workshops; ✓
                  - audit-coverage adequacy: vdd covers spectral-functional + NCG-axiomatic
                    joint clauses; mack covers transit-dynamics + cosmological-bridge joint
                    clauses; ✓
                Step 3: Dispatch vdd Axis-A + mack Axis-B IN PARALLEL via Agent tool spawn;
                        each cross-reviewer receives ONLY the registered §VII.AV STAGE-1-
                        CANDIDATE entry (from W3-1 registry-text edit) + relevant input pins;
                        NEITHER receives W1 + W5 + W8 workshop transcripts.
                Step 4: Collect per-axis verdicts; compute PASS-AND aggregation across joint
                        clauses (logical AND, not OR); verify substrate-input-orthogonality at
                        ≥1 observable.
                Step 5: Emit Option-A corrective canonical line at s92_gate_verdicts.txt with
                        supersedes=d6f990a70111774af2314a814602e510b36154e2c24ff52761bd688c4274771c
                        (full 64-char) tag in value= field.

    Simplify:   PASS: axis_A_vdd_verdict == PASS AND axis_B_mack_verdict == PASS AND ALL joint
                clauses PASS-AND AND substrate_input_orthogonality AND convention_tag.endswith('-FULL')
                ⇔ §VII.AV STAGE-3-PERMANENT eligibility UNBLOCKED + Layer-separability carve-out
                K=1 → K=2 advancement.
                FAIL: ANY clause FAIL on either axis OR substrate-input-orthogonality violated OR
                convention_tag still -SCHEMATIC ⇒ STAGE-3-PERMANENT eligibility BLOCKED; routes
                back to STAGE-1-CANDIDATE per joint-theorem-promotion.md §'Stage 2' FAIL criterion.
                INFO: ALL clauses PASS BUT one cross-reviewer returns INFO on a non-load-bearing
                clause ⇒ STAGE-3-PERMANENT eligibility PROVISIONAL pending INFO clause documentation
                as Stage-2-INFO-deferred per joint-theorem-promotion.md §'Stage 2' INFO criterion.

    Canonical form: Stage-2 PASS-AND structural ceiling under -FULL convention tag with Option-A
                    supersedes IS the §VII.AV STAGE-3-PERMANENT eligibility unblock predicate
                    at the cross-axis verify layer.

    Direction:  PASS ⇒ §VII.AV STAGE-3-PERMANENT eligibility UNBLOCKED + Layer-separability
                carve-out K=1 → K=2 advancement (per mechanical-closure-discipline.md §'Layer-
                separability carve-out' Stage-2 PASS-AND requirement); §VII.AV becomes framework's
                THIRD cross-axis joint theorem at STAGE-3-PERMANENT eligibility (after §VII.AH
                at S90 W2 CF-20 and §VII.U.2 Corner II Var_a at S91 W4 if W4-4-EMPIRICAL-ANCHOR-
                RECONCILIATION lands at S92 W4). FAIL ⇒ STAGE-3 eligibility BLOCKED; routes
                back to STAGE-1-CANDIDATE for substrate-physics remediation.

    Conclusion: W3-11 closes the §VII.AV refinement-pathway STAGE-3-PERMANENT eligibility chain
                via Stage-2 PASS-AND cross-axis verify at structural ceiling under -FULL
                convention with Option-A supersedes tag.

substrate_framing: |
  The §VII.AV Stage-2 cross-axis verify IS the substrate's intrinsic cross-axis independence
  test at the joint-theorem-promotion 4-stage pathway Stage 2 of 4. The substrate IS the
  spectral triple (A_K, H_K, D_K(τ_fold)) at the substrate-distance-2 pole s=4 cocycle
  pairing; the two cross-reviewers vdd + mack ARE methodology-floor F-image probes of the
  substrate-IS observable from STRUCTURALLY ORTHOGONAL axes (spectral-functional vs
  cosmological-bridge).

  Direction: Substrate (BdG sub-algebra M_2(C) ⊂ A_K spectral-distance-2 pole s=4 cocycle
  pairing) IS the substrate-IS observable → Methodology image under F (2-axis cross-reviewer
  Stage-2 verify: vdd Axis-A spectral-side + mack Axis-B transit-side; both operate WITHOUT
  prior workshop context) → Audit-floor image (PASS-AND aggregation + substrate-input-
  orthogonality at ≥1 observable + convention tag -FULL transition + Option-A corrective
  canonical line with supersedes tag).

  Cross-axis independence per joint-theorem-promotion.md §'Stage 2' is structurally
  load-bearing: shared-context-produced agreement is FORBIDDEN as evidence per
  epistemic-discipline.md §'What Does NOT Count as Evidence' item 2; the cross-reviewers
  MUST operate WITHOUT prior workshop context to produce structurally-independent
  agreement that ENTERS the joint-theorem registry per the 4-stage pathway.

  Substrate-input-orthogonality structural ceiling (per joint-theorem-promotion.md
  §'Substrate-input-orthogonality clause' MANDATORY K=3 since S90 W2 CF-20): for Stage-2
  verification with N ≥ 2 observables, ∃ obs_i such that the data file consumed by obs_i
  is loaded by exactly ONE cross-reviewer. At this gate's structural ceiling: vdd Axis-A
  consumes the SCHEMATIC route data (B_SCHEMATIC from W3-8) on its side; mack Axis-B
  consumes the FULL-CC route data (B_FULL_CC from W1 CF-W9-4 + W3-8) on its side. The
  FULL-CC observable is loaded by mack ONLY ⇒ substrate-input-orthogonality satisfied
  at ≥1 observable ⇒ PASS-AND IS at structural ceiling (not at procedural floor with
  substrate-input-overlap caveat).

  Convention tag -SCHEMATIC → -FULL transition: the S91 W8-CF-68 PRE-REG-INC line was
  emitted under -SCHEMATIC convention because the W1 CF-W9-4 FULL-CC pipeline had not
  landed at S91 W8 dispatch time. THIS gate's corrective canonical line transitions to
  -FULL convention tag post-W1 CF-W9-4 PASS at S92 W1; the convention tag change IS the
  methodology-floor F-image of the substrate-IS PROXY-REFINEMENT discharge progression
  (PROXY-REFINEMENT NOT-discharged at S91 W1-2 SCHEMATIC ⇒ PROXY-REFINEMENT discharged
  or partial at S92 W1 FULL-CC; the -SCHEMATIC → -FULL convention transition records
  this discharge progression in the audit trail).

  OAA exclusion {connes-ncg, phonon-first, volovik} per session-92-context.md line 264:
  the W1 + W5 + W8 cluster owned by volovik PRIMARY at S91; Stage-2 cross-axis verify
  candidates EXCLUDE those agents to satisfy joint-theorem-promotion.md §'Stage-2 Axis-B
  Selection Protocol' original-authoring-agent-exclusion-with-downstream-inheritance-reach
  clause. vdd (Axis-A) + mack (Axis-B) satisfy axis-distinctness + original-authoring-
  agent-exclusion + audit-coverage-adequacy 3-condition conjunction.

  Container-thinking violation FORBIDDEN: "Stage-2 verify IS a bureaucratic verification
  device" — inverted: "Stage-2 PASS-AND at structural ceiling IS the substrate's intrinsic
  cross-axis independence test; the methodology-floor F-image of the substrate's own
  cross-axis structural orthogonality at the joint-theorem-promotion 4-stage pathway".
```

## Wave 3 → Wave 8 Decision Point

W3 outcomes feed S92 W8 (§VII.AY + §VII.AZ + HH^1 + Pati-Salam cluster per `session-92-context.md` line 254 W7 dispatch ordering; W8 cluster carries CF-W8-CONSOLIDATED-1 §VII.AY Element 5 corrigendum + CF-W8-CONSOLIDATED-11 §W8-7 re-dispatch + HH^1 first-extraction at substrate-distance-2 pole s=4) plus downstream STAGE-3-PERMANENT eligibility consequences for §VII.AV. The per-verdict consequence map below enumerates the branching at each PASS/FAIL/INFO outcome of W3-11 (the most load-bearing W3 verdict) plus the additional branches at W3-3 / W3-5 / W3-6 / W3-7 / W3-8 / W3-9 outcomes.

### W3-11 PASS-AND (Stage-2 cross-axis verify PASS at structural ceiling)

- **§VII.AV STAGE-3-PERMANENT eligibility UNBLOCKED**: per `joint-theorem-promotion.md §"Stage 3"` — replace `STAGE-1-CANDIDATE-PENDING-STAGE-2` tag with `STAGE-3-PERMANENT` at `sessions/permanent-results-registry.md §VII.AV` (Cell IV × s=4 slot). Mack sole-writer per `feedback_mack-bridge-role.md` carries the tag-update edit; orchestrator session-end synthesis updates the registry tag in the S92 W4 hygiene wave OR S92 W8 §VII.AY-class corrigendum batch landing.
- **Layer-separability carve-out K=1 → K=2 advancement**: per `mechanical-closure-discipline.md §"Layer-separability carve-out (admissible-with-conditions)"` K-counter — §VII.AV becomes the K=2 calibration corpus instance for the Layer-separability carve-out (W4-2 / §W8-90 candidate landing at S88 was K=1). Rule status SUGGESTION preserved (not yet MANDATORY) pending K=3 future calibration instance.
- **§VII.AV becomes framework's THIRD cross-axis joint theorem at STAGE-3-PERMANENT** (per `joint-theorem-promotion.md` 4-stage pathway 1st-of-4 → 4th-of-4 progression): §VII.AH STAGE-3-PERMANENT at S90 W2 CF-20 (first); §VII.U.2 Corner II Var_a STAGE-3-PERMANENT eligibility CONDITIONAL on S92 W4 W4-4-EMPIRICAL-ANCHOR-RECONCILIATION + CF-S92-VII-U-2-STAGE-3-PROMOTION landing (second); §VII.AV STAGE-3-PERMANENT eligibility (third candidate at S92 W3-11 PASS-AND).
- **Cross-axis JOINT-WIN K-counter advancement K=7 → K=8 candidate**: §VII.AV PASS-AND becomes calibration corpus instance #8 for cross-axis JOINT-WIN per S91 W8 §W8-4 advancement campaign (current K=7 candidate post-W8 §VII.AZ.OP-PROJ landing).

### W3-11 FAIL (Stage-2 ANY clause FAIL OR substrate-input-orthogonality violated OR convention tag still -SCHEMATIC)

- **§VII.AV stays at STAGE-1-CANDIDATE**: STAGE-3-PERMANENT eligibility BLOCKED; FAILing clauses route to next-session remediation per `joint-theorem-promotion.md §"Stage 2"` FAIL criterion.
- **Routes to W3-7 alternative envelope predictor + W3-9 layer-attribution disambiguation outcomes**: substrate-physics remediation pathway is determined by which W3 substrate-physics gate outcomes inform the FAIL:
  - W3-7 PASS + W3-9 PASS (single slot) ⇒ FAIL is at the SCHEMATIC vs FULL convention transition layer; W3-11 retry at S93+ post-W3-7 alternative envelope predictor consumption is the corrective path.
  - W3-7 PASS + W3-9 FAIL (split slot) ⇒ FAIL is at the operator-side / state-side layer; §VII.AV slot SPLITS into §VII.AV.OP-PROJ + §VII.AV.STATE-PROJ MANDATORY; new W3-11-analog gate per split slot.
  - W3-7 FAIL ⇒ FAIL is at the substrate-physics envelope-predictor layer; substrate-physics workshop dispatch (per Investigating-Workshops.md 4-condition workshop definition) is the corrective path.
- **§VII.AV STAGE-3-PERMANENT eligibility DEFERRED to S93+**: §VII.AV remains framework's THIRD cross-axis joint theorem CANDIDATE at STAGE-1; STAGE-3-PERMANENT advances only after FAIL diagnosis + substrate-physics remediation + re-attempted Stage-2 PASS-AND.

### W3-11 INFO (PASS-AND with INFO on non-load-bearing clause)

- **§VII.AV STAGE-3-PERMANENT eligibility PROVISIONAL**: STAGE-1-CANDIDATE retained pending Stage-2-INFO-deferred clause documentation per `joint-theorem-promotion.md §"Stage 2"` INFO criterion.
- **Stage-2-INFO-deferred clause queued for S93+ remediation**: the INFO clause is documented in the §VII.AV registry-text entry as a Stage-2-INFO-deferred item; downstream §VII.AV STAGE-3-PERMANENT eligibility advances only after INFO clause resolution at S93+.
